title: Energy maximum principle for vectorial higher order absolute minimisers in $L^\infty$ and $L^p$
summary: We show that vectorial absolute minimisers of general $k$-th order supremal functionals in $W^{k,\infty}(Ω,\mathbb R^N)$ satisfy a maximum principle of the form $$ \max_{\overline U} \mathrm{H} \big(\cdot, u, \mathrm D u, ..., \mathrm D^{k}u\big)=\max_{\partial U}\mathrm{H} \big(\cdot, u, \mathrm D u, ..., \mathrm D^{k}u\big), \qquad\forall\ U\subseteqΩ\mbox{ open}, $$ suitably interpreted. This is only necessary for absolute minimisers, whilst it characterises a relevant weaker notion of absolute minimality involving compactly supported variations.
